text:
megan: heads-up: linkcheck failed on prod-preview. example anchors missing for headings containing ellipses and soft-hyphens.
tony: saw the CI output:
```
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./guides/upgrade.mdx: anchor not found: upgrade-guide--breaking-changes
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./howto/paths.mdx: anchor not found: pathormatxamples
```
lina: likely stray U+00AD / U+2026 in content. mkdocs and docusaurus slugify differ.
megan: quick patch idea: tiny normalizer in CI that replaces U+2026 with "...", removes ­ and zero-width spaces, then collapses runs of spaces. keeps changes minimal.
tony: can we add a unit test in docs-lint that slugifies a few problematic headings with both slugifiers to catch regressions?
lina: yes, i'll add a jest test and a perl one-liner in the pre-linkcheck step: `perl -C -pe "s/[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}\x{00AD}]//g; s/\x{2026}/.../g; s/\s{2,}/ /g;" -i \$f`
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1533 - adds sanitizer + test + migration note. CI queued.
megan: please include a short note in docs/migration.md explaining which characters we normalize. helps downstream tooling.
tony: after merge we should run a non-destructive backfill (dry-run then commit). infra prefers a single signed maintenance commit for these fixes.
lina: noted. i'll coordinate with eng-infra for the backfill.
ci-bot: CI passed for PR #1533.
megan: merging and scheduling backfill. will report back here when it's done.
ci-bot: backfill complete: 35 files modified, commit pushed by infra-bot `docs: normalize invisible chars and ellipsis to fix anchors`
tony: reran linkcheck on preview - all green now.
megan: great work, thanks everyone. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
